description: Create a service visitors can book, such as a 45-minute haircut. It has no staff yet: add people or tables with replo_booking_staff_add before anyone can book it. Unset rules get the defaults: 30-minute slot spacing, 1 person at a time, no buffer, 60 minutes' notice, 60 days ahead, no reminder. For multi-step Replo work, read the replo skill (call skills with name "replo").

addOns.description: Extras a visitor can add, such as a beard trim

bookingWindowDays.description: How far ahead visitors can book

bufferMinutes.description: Free minutes kept after each booking

createsMeetLink.description: Adds a Google Meet link when the host has a calendar to write events to

key.description: Stable identifier a form's booking question uses, such as mens-cut

location.description: Street address or meeting link, shown to the visitor

minimumNoticeMinutes.description: How soon before the start a visitor can still book

projectId.description: The project that owns the forms, from list_projects

reminderHoursBefore.description: Hours before the start to send a reminder; null sends none

slotIntervalMinutes.description: Minutes between start times offered to visitors

name: replo_booking_services_create
title: Create a booking service
